{{Quote|I must make amends, or surely I shall die of shame! Although I'll admit there are worse ways to die.|Mavin|<ref name="TPE" />}}
'''Mavin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Five]], a reclusive evil-worshipping cult that lived within the mysterious region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]]. Mavin and his compatriots spent [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] unfortunate travelers&mdash;notably, they [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Wutzek]], the last known surviving [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Five captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], along with a group of [[Torgaigne]] gangsters from nearby [[Attahox/Legends|Attahox]]. Mavin, a bloodthirsty killer, used a weapon called a [[black fireclaw]] to brutally kill the Torgaigne, before the Five proceeded to psychologically torment Organa and Solo. However, Chewbacca freed Wutzek before the Five could kill his friends, and the unleashed demon utterly destroyed Mavin and his fellows.<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mavin appeared in ''[[The Pandora Effect]]'', a [[1981]] comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and published in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 151]]. In the story, Mavin was drawn by [[Adolfo Buylla]].<ref name="TPE" />
